messages:
fiona: Quick sync: proposal to swap immediate pagers for a grouped digest + gated replay sandbox for autofallbacks. Aim: reduce alert noise but keep debuggability.
sam: Sounds good. How does grouped digest differ from the digests we've discussed before?
fiona: Grouped digest = cluster fallbacks by route + reason_code within a sliding window and send one digest entry with representative samples instead of N pages.
noah: Important: we need an immutable decision_trace stream for compliance. Digest is for ops, decision_trace is for audits and must be append-only.
ux-elena: Console idea: show a "replay" button on the audit card that opens a sandboxed replay UI (admin-only). The audit card itself shows humanized reason, machine code, sample_excerpt (redacted) and a tiny timeline.
audit-bot: policy: any stored excerpt must have a redaction_level tag. redaction_level==none requires approval ticket.
sam: For grouping algorithm: use keys: (route, reason_code, degrade_type). Cluster if same key within 3m and fallback_count>3 then group. Representative sample = median latency sample.
noah: Schema needs to be flat. Proposed fields: evt_id, ts, route, reason_code, degrade_type, representative_prompt_sig, representative_excerpt_redacted, decision_codes_csv, decision_trace_sig, telemetry_tags_csv, alert_eligible_true_false, retention_days.
ux-elena: UX: on the rollout row add a small "grouped digest" pill when enabled. Clicking expands digest with a short list of clusters and a "view sample" affordance. Show redaction status.
oncall: Paging rule: page only if grouped_unique_routes_5m >= 6 OR if any hard-degrade event with p99 latency spike > 5x baseline. Otherwise send grouped digest. Will validate thresholds with SLO owners.
fiona: Replay gating: replay button requires admin RBAC + audit log entry when used. Replays should execute against a synthetic prompt generator (no real PII) unless explicit compliance approval.
sam: Telemetry: emit metrics grouped_fallback_clusters_1h, grouped_suppressed_pages_24h, replay_runs_count. Those help tune algorithm.
noah: Retention: decision_trace stream = 365 days, redacted samples = 30 days default, configurable per-tenant. Add retention_days field to the flat event so downstream jobs can enforce TTL.
ux-elena: Also include a tiny note on the audit card about why digest suppressed a page (e.g., "suppressed: duplicates within 3m"). That reduces confusion for oncall.
audit-bot: reminder: schema changes need migration plan + 2-week staged rollout.
fiona: Action items: sam -> draft grouping algo + PR with example flat JSON, noah -> decision_trace stream spec + retention enforcement, ux-elena -> console mock and replay gating flow, oncall -> validate paging thresholds. Back in one week for sign-off. :+1:
